_comment: Manual corrections to primary-listing resolution. Same discipline as refdata_tables.json: one version-controlled file, edited by hand, read by the pipeline, never written by it except via --write-review-stub. An entry here WINS over anything GLEIF or OpenFIGI return.
_why: Venue alone cannot distinguish a primary listing from a secondary. Frankfurt, Vienna and Milan all host cross-listings of foreign companies, and blocking venues one at a time is whack-a-mole. So the resolver flags every listing outside the issuer's domicile as cross_listing_risk and a human settles it once, here.

_schema.ticker: OpenFIGI ticker for the primary line, e.g. 'STMPA'
_schema.exchange: Bloomberg exchange code, e.g. 'FP' for Euronext Paris
_schema.exclude: true to drop the entity from the screening universe entirely
_schema.note: why - this is the audit trail, not decoration
_schema.reviewed: ISO date the decision was made
